name: humagent
description: Comment on, rewrite, and answer local pages and apps, then send your AI agent one structured review.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp src/ui/*.html src/ui/*.css dist/ui/ && cp src/examples/*.html src/examples/*.css dist/examples/ && rm dist/examples/*.d.ts && chmod 755 dist/cli/index.js
scripts.format: bunx --bun --no-install oxfmt src test tsconfig*.json package.json turbo.json
scripts.format:check: bunx --bun --no-install oxfmt --check src test tsconfig*.json package.json turbo.json
scripts.test: bun run check && bun run test:browser:built
scripts.check: HUMAGENT_CHECK_RUNTIME="$(node -p '[process.platform,process.arch,require("os").release(),process.version].join("/")')/$(bun --version)" turbo run format:check lint build typecheck test:fast --output-logs=new-only
scripts.check:release: bun run release:pack && (test ! -f ".local/release/packages/$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.tgz" || bun run release:verify)
scripts.release: test -f CHANGELOG.md && bun run check:release && (test -f ".local/release/packages/$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.tgz" || test "$(npm view "$npm_package_name@$npm_package_version" version)" = "$npm_package_version") && changeset publish --from-pack-dir .local/release
scripts.release:verify: bun run check --force && (test -z "$CI" || playwright install --with-deps --only-shell chromium) && bun run test:browser:built

author: Georgii Bukharov
